Partners & supporters

A stronger circle of support.

01

Venues & production professionals

Host a training Saturday, or take trainees onto your event crew. You get a trained, supervised crew that knows your room — and when a call comes in, they will say your name.

02

Youth & community organisations

Help shape a referral pathway that respects consent, privacy and each young person’s goals, with clear boundaries between training and specialist care.

03

Donors & equipment supporters

Help keep the course free. Working AV equipment is welcome too — we collect anywhere in the GTA.

Start a partnership conversation

Training ground

Faithfire Production · 139 Millwick Dr

Where Saturday training runs.

Participants soundcheck a real band at Faithfire and, from week three, crew real events with partner venues across the GTA — supervised, but real.

Opportunity is a team effort.

Venues, community organisations, donors and equipment supporters welcome
